Access.name: isAlmenoUnClienteCointestatarioPuro
Access.Query:
select CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END from CLL.CLIAGE A where A.AGE_C = '0000000000' AND A.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and trunc(sysdate) between A.CLIAGE_D_INIZ and A.CLIAGE_D_FINE AND A.CLI_C =
inputCodiceCliente AND A.CLI_C IN (inputElencoCodiciCliente)

Access.name: isCodiceFiscaleAgente
Access.Query:
select case when count(*) > 0 then 'S' else 'N' end from INR_AGENTI A, INR_AGE E where A.AGE_C_AGE = E.AGE_C_AGE and E.CICLOVITA_C_CICLO_VITA = 'A' and A.AGE_X_CF_AGE =
inputCodiceFiscale

Access.name: isResidenzaFisicaEstera
Access.Query: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END AS isResidenzaFisicaEstera FROM CLL.V_INDCLI WHERE TIPIND_C_TIP_IND = '01' AND NAZ_C_NAZ != 'I' AND CLI_C = ?

Access.name: isResidenzaFisicaEsteraProspect
Access.Query: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END AS isResFisEsteraProspect FROM CLL.INR_INDCLI_ELETTR_REP WHERE TIPIND_C_TIP_IND = '01' AND NAZ_C_NAZ != 'I' AND ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = ?

Access.name: residenzaFiscalePredominante
Access.Query: SELECT DATO FROM CLL.CLI_DATIAGGIUNTIVI WHERE CODICE_DATO = 3140 AND CLI_C = ?

Access.name: gradoRischioResidenzaFisica
Access.Query: select distinct pae.COD_RISCH_RICLAGG AS gradoRischioResidenzaFisica from cll.v_indcli cli inner join utly.dom_naz naz on cli.NAZ_C_NAZ = naz.COD_NAZ_CLI inner join cll.paestero pae on naz.cod_naz_uic_cdcri = pae.paestero_c_uic where naz.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and pae.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and cli.TIPIND_C_TIP_IND = '01' and sysdate between naz.DAT_INIZ_VALID and naz.DAT_FINE_VALID and cli.CLI_C = ?

Access.name: gradoRischioResidenzaFisicaProspect
Access.Query: select distinct pae.COD_RISCH_RICLAGG AS gradoRischioResidenzaFisicaProspect from cll.INR_INDCLI_ELETTR_REP cli inner join utly.dom_naz naz on cli.NAZ_C_NAZ = naz.COD_NAZ_CLI inner join cll.paestero pae on naz.cod_naz_uic_cdcri = pae.paestero_c_uic WHERE naz.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and pae.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and cli.TIPIND_C_TIP_IND = '01' and sysdate between naz.DAT_INIZ_VALID and naz.DAT_FINE_VALID AND cli.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = ?
